votesHelp.title: Reading the votes
votesHelp.opensAnswer: Opens what is behind the answer
votesHelp.body: Each column is a reviewer and each row a criterion, with their vote in the last row. Press a face for that reviewer's vote and note. Press an answer for what is behind it, which is the passage a model read or a person's vote and note. A model that couldn't read a paper has no say in it.
